name: Marazones ~Mitsurin no Daihihou~
original_name: マラゾネス～密林の大秘宝～
source:
Professor Scott seeks a hidden treasure in the barbaric lost woods along with his girlfriend and assistant, Jennifer. The adventurous archaeologists encounter an amazoness with a throbbing c*ck...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ139388.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
斯科特教授与女友兼助手珍妮弗一同在野蛮的失落丛林中寻找隐藏的宝藏。这对热衷冒险的考古学家遇到了一名下体勃起的亚马逊女战士……
